Exalt (bc Sacred Heart) > 2 or 3 cost >= defense (bc it's actually not bad with talent on top and can soften the blow a bit) > strike

For Pollux (dps) Saya (dmg amp with corrosion + discard, pcaro enabler) Aigis (vuln and some keyflare and stall for 1 turn), the last slot can be someone who can tank or utility, either Salvador (oops limited arc1 but he can spook in standard) or maybe Erica (sorry me not play her at all), Cassiah or even Horla DR (Leap for moodsetting) with Pollux turboing killing enemies before they can grill you
ive seen in some infographics that saya is bad with pollux, is that true? ive been running him w thais aigis horla rn (all lvl 50)

Not necessary BAD but when she discards she'll discard all command cards (not buffer cards), hence workaround her is a bit tricky. 
Ofc there're ways tho. Considering Saya inflicts bazillion corrosion and it's a waste to NOT use all of it, Pollux is *weirdly* can deal a s tons of damage even with that shortcoming of yeeted his cards (esp SH).

Pollux's SH (sin mark stack + bleed) > Saya 0 card corro + discard > Pollux posse (it's RNG) > Pollux exalt (dmg + free SH) > SH > any free cardo

The corrosion will be triggered by both the dps punched directly by Pollux AND his bleed (trigger later)

Also if you're running Thais Aigis Horla: that's a wee bit a lot of keyflare pumping but for beginner it's fine
Thais can replace Aigis in vuln applying, Thais is also weakness applier and keyflare pump with alie pump (on top of copying card but that's the other stuff). Horla in E1 (if you have her E1 btw) she's a debuff monster and overlaps w Thais in debuff applying (but Hola is 1 turn while Thais is 2 turns + keyflare).
Eventually you'll use two or one of them tho.
